# Factory drum kits

Both kits contain 16 one-shots distributed under [CC0 1.0 Universal](CC0-1.0.txt).

- **Acoustic** comes from [Virtuosity Drums](https://versilian-studios.com/virtuosity-drums/) by Versilian Studios and Karoryfer Samples, performed by Austin McMahon. The files come from [upstream revision 9f04cf9](https://github.com/sfzinstruments/virtuosity_drums/tree/9f04cf9a734527edfbb0a4eee1f674e45bbf71bc).
- **Electronic / Dance** uses synthesized hits by Kevin B. (Fugue State Audio) from the [Stargate Sample Pack](https://github.com/stargatedaw/stargate-sample-pack/tree/dbfd6ec52d4ed53b60bdbea5fc6adf295127c027/stargate-sample-pack/fugue-state-audio).

8track trimmed the acoustic one-shots and adjusted individual playback levels and tail fades for both kits. The files are stored as 16-bit FLAC at their original sample rates.
